title: FolderNest v2.0.6 Official Release
changelog: • Remember Last Root Persistence: Robust session saving and auto-load on start.
• Title & Header: Clean display of FolderNest 2.0.6 across window and header.
• Rebranded to FolderNest: Clean, modern and punchy project generator.
• New Radiant Red & Fiery Orange 3D Icon: Ultra-visible warm glowing folder & golden rocket logo.
• Windows Right-Click Integration: Instant project creation from Explorer context menus.
• Clean Spacious UI: Restored perfectly balanced full-width Root & Template path inputs.
• Custom Template Isolation, Clean Success Dialog, and Auto-Close on Finish.
